import { provide } from 'vue';
import { DnDProvider, type Active, type AnnouncedPosition, type Announcements } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Builder from './Builder.vue';
import { BUILDER, LAYERS, PAGE, createBuilder } from './builder';
import { BLOCKS, SECTIONS, excerpt, isColumn, isSection, type ChipData, type LayerNode } from './page';

// Provided above the provider: the overlays it renders copy the page's look from it.
const builder = createBuilder();
provide(BUILDER, builder);

/** What a drag carries, in words: "the Hero section", "a new Pricing section", "the heading “…”". */
const what = (active: Active) => {
  const node = active.items[0]?.item as LayerNode | undefined;
  // A chip of the palette: a plain draggable, with no list item.
  if (!node) return `a new ${BLOCKS[(active.data as ChipData).kind].name.toLowerCase()}`;
  if (isSection(node)) return `${builder.find(node.id) ? 'the' : 'a new'} ${SECTIONS[node.kind].name} section`;
  if (isColumn(node)) return 'the column';
  return `the ${BLOCKS[node.kind].name.toLowerCase()} “${excerpt(node)}”`;
};

/** Where a position of a list is, in words. */
const where = ({ list, index, length }: AnnouncedPosition) => {
  const place = `${index + 1} of ${length}`;
  if (list === PAGE) return `position ${place} on the page`;
  if (list === LAYERS) return `row ${place} of the layers`;
  const at = builder.find(String(list));
  if (!at?.column) return `position ${place}`;
  return `position ${place} in column ${at.section.columns.indexOf(at.column) + 1} of ${SECTIONS[at.section.kind].name}`;
};

const announcements: Partial<Announcements> = {
  onDragStart: ({ active }) => `Picked up ${what(active)}.`,
  onDragOver: ({ active }, { position }) => (position ? `${what(active)}, ${where(position)}` : undefined),
  onDragEnd: ({ active, dropped }, { position }) => (dropped && position ? `Dropped ${what(active)} at ${where(position)}.` : undefined),
  onDragCancel: ({ active }) => `Cancelled. Nothing changed for ${what(active)}.`,
};

// Space picks up and drops. Enter is left to the editor: it edits a text, adds a template.
const keyboard = { keys: { start: ['Space'], drop: ['Space', 'Enter'], cancel: ['Escape'] } };
const instructions =
  'Space picks up; the arrow keys move; Space drops; Escape cancels. Enter edits the focused text, or adds the focused template.';
</script>

  <DnDProvider :announcements="announcements" :keyboard="keyboard" :screen-reader-instructions="instructions">
    <Builder />
  </DnDProvider>

import { computed } from 'vue';
import { DragPreview, type Active, type DnDStatus, type DragItem, type DropDestination } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import BlockView from './BlockView.vue';
import { useBuilder } from './builder';
import { BLOCKS, SECTIONS, TONES, typeScale, type Block, type ChipData } from './page';

/**
 * The overlay of blocks: one of the page's, or a chip of the palette. Over a column, the
 * real block in the colors of the section it would go into. The box takes the size of the
 * block's slot there (`overlayFit: 'slot'`), and the block lays out in it as it will on drop.
 */
const props = defineProps<{ active: Active; items: DragItem[]; status: DnDStatus; to: DropDestination | null }>();
const { find, pageWidth } = useBuilder();

// A block of the page, or what a chip makes (`createItem` makes the same).
const block = computed<Block>(
  () => (props.items[0]!.item as Block | undefined) ?? { ...BLOCKS[(props.active.data as ChipData).kind].spec, id: 'new' },
);

// The column it would go into (`to.list` is the column's id): its section's tone.
const look = computed(() => {
  const at = props.to && find(String(props.to.list));
  return at ? { ...TONES[SECTIONS[at.section.kind].tone], ...typeScale(pageWidth.value) } : null;
});
</script>

import { computed, inject, ref, type InjectionKey } from 'vue';
import {
  BLOCKS,
  copySection,
  createBlock,
  createPage,
  createSection,
  type Block,
  type BlockKind,
  type Column,
  type Section,
  type SectionKind,
} from './page';

/**
 * The editor's state: the page, what is selected and edited, the preview width, and the
 * history. Drops change the page through the lists; the buttons and shortcuts call the
 * actions here. Each change is then one step of undo.
 */

/** The sortable lists' ids: drop events, the overlay's `to` and announcements name them. */
export const PAGE = 'page';
export const LAYERS = 'layers';

export type Device = 'desktop' | 'tablet' | 'mobile';
export const DEVICES: Record<Device, { name: string; width: string }> = {
  desktop: { name: 'Desktop', width: '100%' },
  tablet: { name: 'Tablet', width: '768px' },
  mobile: { name: 'Mobile', width: '390px' },
};

/** Where a node is on the page: its section, and for a column or a block, its column. */
interface Place {
  section: Section;
  sectionIndex: number;
  column?: Column;
  block?: Block;
  blockIndex: number;
}

/** History steps kept for undo. */
const HISTORY = 100;

export function createBuilder() {
  const sections = ref<Section[]>(createPage());
  /** The selected section or block, by id: the hero to start with. */
  const selected = ref<string | null>(sections.value[1]?.id ?? null);
  /** The node under the pointer in the layers panel: the canvas outlines it. */
  const hovered = ref<string | null>(null);
  /** The block whose texts are being edited. */
  const editing = ref<string | null>(null);
  const device = ref<Device>('desktop');
  /** The page's width on screen: its type scale, read by the overlays too. */
  const pageWidth = ref(0);

  const find = (id: string | null): Place | null => {
    if (!id) return null;
    for (const [sectionIndex, section] of sections.value.entries()) {
      if (section.id === id) return { section, sectionIndex, blockIndex: -1 };
      for (const column of section.columns) {
        if (column.id === id) return { section, sectionIndex, column, blockIndex: -1 };
        const blockIndex = column.blocks.findIndex((block) => block.id === id);
        if (blockIndex >= 0) return { section, sectionIndex, column, block: column.blocks[blockIndex], blockIndex };
      }
    }
    return null;
  };

  const select = (id: string | null) => {
    selected.value = id;
    if (editing.value !== id) editing.value = null;
  };

  // ─── History: the page as JSON after each change ─────────────────────────────

  const past = ref<string[]>([]);
  const future = ref<string[]>([]);
  let present = JSON.stringify(sections.value);

  /** Records the page as it is now: after a drop, a button, an edited text. */
  const commit = () => {
    const now = JSON.stringify(sections.value);
    if (now === present) return;
    past.value = [...past.value.slice(-HISTORY + 1), present];
    future.value = [];
    present = now;
  };

  const restore = (snapshot: string) => {
    present = snapshot;
    // New objects with the same ids: the lists animate what moved, nothing else re-renders.
    sections.value = JSON.parse(snapshot);
    editing.value = null;
    if (!find(selected.value)) selected.value = null;
  };

  const undo = () => {
    const previous = past.value.at(-1);
    if (previous === undefined) return;
    past.value = past.value.slice(0, -1);
    future.value = [...future.value, present];
    restore(previous);
  };

  const redo = () => {
    const next = future.value.at(-1);
    if (next === undefined) return;
    future.value = future.value.slice(0, -1);
    past.value = [...past.value, present];
    restore(next);
  };

  // ─── Actions without a drag: clicks, toolbar buttons, shortcuts ──────────────

  const insertSection = (section: Section, index: number) => {
    sections.value = sections.value.toSpliced(index, 0, section);
    selected.value = section.id;
  };

  const insertBlock = (column: Column, block: Block, index: number) => {
    column.blocks = column.blocks.toSpliced(index, 0, block);
    selected.value = block.id;
  };

  /** A template clicked: a new section after the selected one, else at the end. */
  const addSection = (kind: SectionKind) => {
    const at = find(selected.value);
    insertSection(createSection(kind), at ? at.sectionIndex + 1 : sections.value.length);
    commit();
  };

  /** A chip clicked: a new block after the selected block, else at the end of the selected (or last) section's first column. */
  const addBlock = (kind: BlockKind) => {
    const at = find(selected.value ?? sections.value.at(-1)?.id ?? null);
    const column = at?.column ?? at?.section.columns[0];
    if (!at || !column) return;
    insertBlock(column, createBlock(BLOCKS[kind].spec), at.block ? at.blockIndex + 1 : column.blocks.length);
    commit();
  };

  /** A section one slot up (`-1`) or down (`1`). */
  const moveSection = (id: string, by: -1 | 1) => {
    const at = find(id);
    const to = at ? at.sectionIndex + by : -1;
    if (!at || at.column || to < 0 || to >= sections.value.length) return;
    sections.value = sections.value.toSpliced(at.sectionIndex, 1).toSpliced(to, 0, at.section);
    commit();
  };

  /** A copy right after a section or a block, selected. */
  const duplicate = (id: string) => {
    const at = find(id);
    if (at?.block && at.column) insertBlock(at.column, createBlock(at.block), at.blockIndex + 1);
    else if (at && !at.column) insertSection(copySection(at.section), at.sectionIndex + 1);
    else return;
    commit();
  };

  /** Removes a section, or a block (its section is selected then). */
  const remove = (id: string) => {
    const at = find(id);
    if (at?.block && at.column) {
      at.column.blocks = at.column.blocks.filter((block) => block.id !== id);
      select(at.section.id);
    } else if (at && !at.column) {
      sections.value = sections.value.filter((section) => section.id !== id);
      select(null);
    } else return;
    commit();
  };

  return {
    sections,
    selected,
    hovered,
    editing,
    device,
    pageWidth,
    canUndo: computed(() => past.value.length > 0),
    canRedo: computed(() => future.value.length > 0),
    find,
    select,
    commit,
    undo,
    redo,
    addSection,
    addBlock,
    moveSection,
    duplicate,
    remove,
  };
}

export type Builder = ReturnType<typeof createBuilder>;
export const BUILDER: InjectionKey<Builder> = Symbol('builder');

/** The editor's state, provided by index.vue above the provider: the overlays read it too. */
export const useBuilder = () => inject(BUILDER)!;

/** Scrolls `container` just enough to show `element`, without scrolling the page around it. */
export const reveal = (container: HTMLElement | null, element: Element | null | undefined) => {
  if (!container || !element) return;
  const box = container.getBoundingClientRect();
  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  const behavior = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth';
  if (rect.top < box.top) container.scrollBy({ top: rect.top - box.top - 16, behavior });
  else if (rect.bottom > box.bottom) container.scrollBy({ top: Math.min(rect.bottom - box.bottom + 16, rect.top - box.top - 16), behavior });
};

<script setup lang="ts">
import { nextTick, ref, useTemplateRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { useDnD, useDnDMonitor } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Canvas from './Canvas.vue';
import Icon from './Icon.vue';
import Layers from './Layers.vue';
import Palette from './Palette.vue';
import { DEVICES, useBuilder, type Device } from './builder';

const builder = useBuilder();
const { device, pageWidth, selected, canUndo, canRedo } = builder;

// Wide, both panels are docked, Add on the left and Layers on the right. Narrower, they
// share one panel with tabs; narrower still, that panel is a drawer over the canvas.
type Tab = 'add' | 'layers';
const tab = ref<Tab>('add');
const drawer = ref(false);
const toggleDrawer = (next: Tab) => {
  drawer.value = !(drawer.value && tab.value === next);
  tab.value = next;
};

// Every drop is a step of the history: when `onDragEnd` runs, the lists have written it.
useDnDMonitor({ onDragEnd: () => builder.commit() });

// A template or a chip picked up in the drawer: the drawer slides away (it stays mounted:
// the drag's source stays in the page), and the whole canvas shows where the drop goes.
const panel = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('panel');
const addPanel = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('addPanel');
const { active, status } = useDnD();
watch(active, (now) => {
  if (now && addPanel.value?.contains(now.element)) drawer.value = false;
});
const closeOutside = (event: PointerEvent) => {
  if (drawer.value && !panel.value?.contains(event.target as Node)) drawer.value = false;
};

const root = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('root');
/** Gives the focus to the page's control for a node (a section's grip, a block), or keeps it in the editor. */
const focusNode = async (id: string | null) => {
  await nextTick();
  const target = id ? root.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-focus="${id}"]`) : null;
  (target ?? root.value)?.focus();
};

/** The editor's shortcuts, while the focus is in it. A text being edited keeps its own keys. */
const onKeydown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.defaultPrevented || (event.target as HTMLElement).isContentEditable) return;
  const command = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
  const key = event.key.toLowerCase();
  if (command && (key === 'z' || key === 'y')) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (key === 'y' || event.shiftKey) builder.redo();
    else builder.undo();
    return;
  }
  const id = selected.value;
  if (!id || status.value !== 'idle') return;
  if (command && key === 'd') {
    event.preventDefault();
    builder.duplicate(id);
    focusNode(selected.value);
  } else if (key === 'delete' || key === 'backspace') {
    event.preventDefault();
    builder.remove(id);
    focusNode(selected.value);
  } else if (key === 'escape') {
    // Handled here: an expanded docs frame stays open.
    event.preventDefault();
    builder.select(null);
  }
};
</script>

import { computed, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList, useDnD } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import BlockGhost from './BlockGhost.vue';
import PageBlock from './PageBlock.vue';
import { useBuilder } from './builder';
import { BLOCKS, createBlock, type ChipData, type Column } from './page';

const props = defineProps<{ column: Column }>();
const builder = useBuilder();
const { hovered } = builder;

// The column's blocks, written back into the column on drop. A computed rather than
// `toRef`: undo puts new objects in the page, this column's among them.
const blocks = computed({
  get: () => props.column.blocks,
  set: (value) => (props.column.blocks = value),
});

const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
const { active } = useDnD();
// Every column of every section is a list of one group: blocks move between all of them,
// and sort live, so the page shows the result while you drag.
const { items, isOver, isAccepting } = makeSortableList(list, {
  id: props.column.id,
  items: blocks,
  group: 'blocks',
  // A section in hand passes over the columns: they step aside. With `createItem`, they
  // would take it for a chip, refuse it, and hide the page's line under them.
  disabled: () => !!active.value?.type.includes('sections'),
  // A block in hand, and a chip over a column: the real block, in the section's colors.
  overlay: BlockGhost,
  animateChanges: true,
  // The palette's chips are plain draggables: the column makes the block their `data` names.
  createItem: (active) => {
    const kind = (active.data as ChipData | undefined)?.kind;
    return kind ? createBlock(BLOCKS[kind].spec) : undefined;
  },
  onDrop: (event) => builder.select(event.items[0]!.id),
});
</script>

</script>

import { makeSortableItem, useDnD, type FlatNode } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Icon from './Icon.vue';
import { useBuilder } from './builder';
import { BLOCKS, SECTIONS, excerpt, isColumn, isSection, levelOf, type LayerNode } from './page';

const props = defineProps<{ node: FlatNode<LayerNode> }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ toggle: [] }>();
const builder = useBuilder();
const { selected, hovered } = builder;

/** Px per level: the tree's `indentation`. */
const INDENT = 14;

const item = computed(() => props.node.item);
const row = computed(() => {
  const node = item.value;
  if (isSection(node)) return { icon: SECTIONS[node.kind].icon, name: SECTIONS[node.kind].name, detail: '' };
  if (isColumn(node)) return { icon: 'column' as const, name: `Column ${props.node.index + 1}`, detail: '' };
  return { icon: BLOCKS[node.kind].icon, name: BLOCKS[node.kind].name, detail: excerpt(node) };
});
// A column row selects its section: columns are the sections' frame, not things to pick.
const target = computed(() => (isColumn(item.value) ? builder.find(item.value.id)?.section.id : item.value.id) ?? null);

const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
// Columns take blocks, but stay where they are.
const { indicator } = makeSortableItem(el, {
  id: () => props.node.key,
  disabled: () => isColumn(item.value),
});

// The line starts at the depth the drop lands at; red where the row can't go (a block between sections).
const { active } = useDnD();
const line = computed(() => {
  const at = indicator.value;
  if (!at || at.side === 'inside') return null;
  const dragged = active.value?.items[0]?.item as LayerNode | undefined;
  const depth = at.depth ?? 0;
  return {
    side: at.side,
    left: `${(depth - props.node.depth) * INDENT + 8}px`,
    refused: !!dragged && levelOf(dragged) !== depth,
  };
});
const into = computed(() => indicator.value?.side === 'inside');
</script>

import { nextTick, ref, useTemplateRef, watch, type Ref } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableTree, type Key } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import LayerRow from './LayerRow.vue';
import { LAYERS, reveal, useBuilder } from './builder';
import { isColumn, isSection, levelOf, type Block, type Column, type LayerNode } from './page';

const builder = useBuilder();
const { sections, selected } = builder;

/** Rows have keys of their own: the canvas's lists already drag these ids, and keys are the provider's. */
const keyOf = (node: LayerNode) => `layer-${node.id}`;

/** Sections whose rows are closed: all but the selected one to start with. */
const collapsed = ref(new Set<Key>(sections.value.filter((section) => section.id !== selected.value).map(keyOf)));
const toggle = (key: Key) => (collapsed.value.has(key) ? collapsed.value.delete(key) : collapsed.value.add(key));

const root = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('root');
const tree = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('tree');
// The page itself, as a tree: the same sections, columns and blocks the canvas shows, so a
// row moved here moves on the page too. It stays still while you drag: a line shows where
// the row goes, and how deep.
const { items } = makeSortableTree(tree, {
  id: LAYERS,
  items: sections as Ref<LayerNode[]>,
  getKey: keyOf,
  getChildren: (node) => (isSection(node) ? node.columns : isColumn(node) ? node.blocks : undefined),
  setChildren: (node, children) => {
    if (isSection(node)) node.columns = children as Column[];
    else if (isColumn(node)) node.blocks = children as Block[];
  },
  // Blocks go into columns, nothing goes into blocks, sections stay at the top.
  canNest: (node, parent) => levelOf(node) === levelOf(parent) + 1,
  maxDepth: 2,
  collapsed,
  placeholder: 'indicator',
  indentation: 14,
  animateChanges: true,
  // A tree takes any row at its top level: a block let go there would become a section. It flies back.
  onBeforeDrop: (event) => (event.to.parentKey !== null || event.items.every(isSection) ? 'accept' : 'reject'),
});

// Selected on the canvas: its section and column open here, and its row comes into view.
watch(selected, async (id) => {
  const at = builder.find(id);
  if (!at) return;
  collapsed.value.delete(keyOf(at.section));
  if (at.column) collapsed.value.delete(keyOf(at.column));
  await nextTick();
  reveal(root.value, root.value?.querySelector(`[data-layer="${id}"]`));
});
</script>

import { BLOCKS, excerpt, type Block } from './page';

const props = defineProps<{ block: Block }>();
const builder = useBuilder();
const { selected, hovered, editing } = builder;

const isSelected = computed(() => selected.value === props.block.id);
const isEditing = computed(() => editing.value === props.block.id);
const info = computed(() => BLOCKS[props.block.kind]);
// "Heading: Know what your users…", for screen readers.
const label = computed(() => [info.value.name, excerpt(props.block)].filter(Boolean).join(': '));

const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
// The whole block drags: a click selects it, a press and a move pick it up. Not while its
// texts are edited: a press then places the caret or selects words.
makeSortableItem(el, {
  item: () => props.block,
  canDrag: () => !isEditing.value,
});

/** Double-click or Enter: the texts become editable, the caret where it was clicked. */
const edit = async (event?: MouseEvent) => {
  if (!info.value.text) return;
  builder.select(props.block.id);
  editing.value = props.block.id;
  await nextTick();
  const clicked = (event?.target as HTMLElement | undefined)?.closest<HTMLElement>('[contenteditable]');
  (clicked ?? el.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[contenteditable]'))?.focus();
  const caret = event && document.caretPositionFromPoint?.(event.clientX, event.clientY);
  if (clicked && caret) getSelection()?.collapse(caret.offsetNode, caret.offset);
};

/** Done editing: one step of the history. Enter and Escape give the focus back to the block. */
const finish = (refocus: boolean) => {
  if (!isEditing.value) return;
  editing.value = null;
  builder.commit();
  if (refocus) el.value?.focus();
};

// A click outside the block's texts ends the editing; moving between its texts doesn't.
const onFocusout = (event: FocusEvent) => {
  if (!el.value?.contains(event.relatedTarget as Node | null)) finish(false);
};

  const verb = builder.find(dragged.id) ? 'Move' : 'Add';

  const same = tools?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(by < 0 ? '.up' : '.down');
